name: thron-memory
description: One private memory for your AI apps. Stored as files on this computer; nothing leaves it.
long_description: Claude remembers what matters to you across chats: people, projects, preferences, decisions and deadlines. Memory is a folder of plain Markdown pages on this computer. Old facts move to History instead of being deleted, and passwords or keys are refused. Want the same memory on your phone and in other AI apps like ChatGPT? See the project page.

memory_folder.title: Memory folder
memory_folder.description: Where your memory pages are saved. The default is fine for most people.

tools.name: overview
tools.description: Your rules for agents and a list of everything remembered

tools.description: Change a fact and keep the old one in History
